oral_examination.oral_examination: 21 were missing, the space in the missing tooth area was acceptable, and no obvious abnormality was found in the alveolar ridge. The crowns of the adjacent missing teeth are intact, there are no obvious periodontal abnormalities, no loosening, and no elongation of the opposing teeth. The remaining teeth are nothing special. No obvious abnormalities were found in the bite.

treatment_plan.notes: 1. You can eat immediately. Do not eat sticky or hard food. 2. If the resin material detaches within 3 months, you can refill it once for free. 3. Maintain oral hygiene, develop good habits of brushing and flossing correctly and conscientiously, conduct regular oral examinations every 3-6 months, and follow up if any discomfort occurs.
